name: MMVP
intro: MMVP通过从 ImageNet-1K 与 LAION-Aesthetics 中筛选 CLIP 表征高度相似但 DINOv2 表征差异显著的“CLIP 盲点对”，评测多模态模型的细粒度视觉落地能力。最终基准含 150 个图像对、300 道直接且无歧义的问题，覆盖方向、存在、状态、数量、位置、外观、结构、文本和视角九类视觉模式；同一图像对的两题都答对才计为正确。
org: New York University, FAIR at Meta, University of California Berkeley
build_method: 双编码器自动筛选, 人工编题
eval_feature: CLIP盲点, 九类视觉模式, 两题全对计分
eval_feature_en: CLIP blind pairs, nine visual patterns, both-questions-correct scoring
intro_en: MMVP evaluates fine-grained visual grounding by mining CLIP-blind pairs from ImageNet-1K and LAION-Aesthetics: pairs with highly similar CLIP representations but dissimilar DINOv2 representations. The final benchmark contains 150 image pairs and 300 direct, unambiguous questions across nine visual patterns—direction, presence, state, count, position, appearance, structure, text, and viewpoint—and a pair is correct only when both associated questions are answered correctly.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart TD
    A[数据源: ImageNet-1K & LAION-Aesthetics] --> B[计算 CLIP 嵌入 (CLIP-ViT-L-14)]
    A --> C[计算 DINOv2 嵌入 (DINOv2-ViT-L-14)]
    B --> D{CLIP 相似度 > 0.95?}
    C --> E{DINOv2 相似度 < 0.6?}
    D -- 是 --> F{CLIP-blind Pair 候选}
    E -- 是 --> F
    F -- 满足条件 --> G[识别 CLIP-blind Pairs]
    G --> H[人工检查 CLIP-blind Pairs]
    H --> I[识别 CLIP 忽略的视觉细节]
    I --> J[设计问题 (150 对, 300 个问题)]
    J --> K[构建 MMVP 基准测试]
    K --> L[Evaluation多模态 LLM (GPT-4V, LLaVA-1.5等)]
    K --> M[进行用户研究 (300 个问题)]
    L --> N{LLM 对 CLIP-blind Pair 的两个问题都回答正确?}
    M --> O[人类表现基线]
    N -- 是 --> P[LLM 评分]
    N -- 否 --> Q[识别 LLM 视觉缺陷]
    P --> R[分析 LLM 性能]
    Q --> R
    R --> S[MMVP 结果]
    O --> S

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2401.06209 Sections 2-3 and Appendix B plus the official MMVP repository. The diagram preserves both source corpora, CLIP ViT-L-14 and DINOv2 ViT-L-14, the exact >0.95/<0.6 thresholds, manual inspection and direct paired-question writing, 150-pair/300-question totals, GPT-4 categorization into all nine named patterns, independent item presentation, randomized human study, and the both-questions-correct paired accuracy rule.
